label: Ask the council for advice
notes: Free action. Triggers a minister briefing on a chosen domain.

label: Rule on a council dispute
notes: Pick a side in an active argument. Swings both ministers' opinion.

label: Recruit someone to court
notes: Draws from the candidate pool. Better candidates cost more and want more.

label: Reward a courtier
notes: Modes: gold title land marriage public_honour. Vain targets respond best.

label: Punish a courtier
notes: Modes: reprimand fine strip_title imprison exile execute. Escalates kin grievance.

label: Investigate a courtier
notes: Requires a Spymaster. Reveals hidden traits loyalty and faction membership.

label: Confide in a courtier
notes: Raises their opinion. A treacherous target may leak what you said.

label: Negotiate with a faction
notes: Concede all part or none of their demand. Partial splits moderates from radicals.

label: Buy off part of a faction
notes: Targets the least committed members. Cheaper than conceding to everyone.

label: Arrange a marriage at court
notes: Binds two courtiers. Creates a kinship link that transmits grievance.

label: Adjust your personal guard
notes: Direct reduction in assassination success chance. Ongoing upkeep.

label: Establish a new council seat
notes: One-off cost to open a seat beyond the founding five.

label: Buy a manor
notes: MANOR_SYSTEM.md §5. params: manor (code, label or cell id). Buys the manor from its house at MapManors.price_of; the house's people warm to the crown.

label: Sell a manor
notes: params: manor. Sells a crown manor back to its province's house at the sell-back price.

label: Build on a manor
notes: params: manor, building (data/manor_buildings.csv). Raises one building on a crown manor for its cost.

label: Seize a manor by force
notes: Skeleton: gated by manor_seize_enabled; automatic success until the military system resolves it. Costs legitimacy, unrest and the house's regard.

label: Set a manor's chief good
notes: params: manor, focus (data/manor_focus.csv). Sets what a crown manor in a province the crown controls works at; costs the focus's switch_cost_gold and ramps up over its transition_ticks.

label: Pull down a building
notes: params: manor, building. Pulls down a finished building or stops one being built on a crown manor; manor_demolish_refund of its cost comes back.

label: Buy goods
notes: spec 2026-09-14 §5. params: pool (strategic|civil), gold. The treasury buys that much of the pool's goods at goods_trade_spread over

label: Sell goods
notes: params: pool (strategic|civil), gold. The treasury sells that much of the pool's goods at goods_trade_spread under

label: Hurry a work on a manor
notes: params: manor, building, days. Pays build_rush_gold_per_day a day to cut days off a work in progress on a crown manor

label: Send a regiment to march
notes: params: regiment (a regiment_code of the player's realm), x, y (the destination in pack pixels, on land for a land regiment). The order rides by courier from the king's saved physical position (a fleet's takes effect at once), and the column moves from the day he reaches it, then covers ArmySystem.day_march_m a day under the clock until it arrives, when it falls back to garrison. Straight-line: there is no pathfinding yet.

label: Move the king
notes: params: x_m, y_m whole metre destination; optional route_m as [[x,y],...]. The king travels by a legal land route and ordinary courier orders depart from his saved location.

label: Join a regiment
notes: params: regiment (a friendly regiment_code); the king rides to rendezvous, then follows its real position.

label: Withdraw the king safely
notes: params: battle_id; only when physically present, withdraws the king without changing battle results, troops, or camps.

label: Halt a regiment where it stands
notes: params: regiment. Cancels a march and holds the ground it has reached.

label: Set a regiment's battle stance
notes: params: regiment, stance (a data/battle_stances.csv row: hold, steady, evade); a front's draft adds facing (a whole degree 0..359) and on_arrival (the stance taken where the march arrives; spec 2026-10-11-war-room-front-line-design). A courier rides to the regiment; the stance fights from the day after he arrives (spec 2026-10-07-enemy-ai-and-battle §4.4).

label: Send a spy
notes: params: x, y (pack px of any point on the map). A spy rides from the capital by the road network (CourierSystem.dispatch_spy) and on arrival files a report on the Missive board — highly credible or rumour by his quality roll (SpySystem).

label: Set a war workshop's rate
notes: params: cell (or manor), rate (0|500|1000). How much of the lord's civil goods a war workshop turns into strategic goods each month (spec 2026-09-30-ledger-supply-design §2).

label: Give a flow to a councillor
notes: params: flow (data/ledger_governance.csv), character (a councillor). He governs it from now on; the one passed over takes it ill (spec 2026-09-30-ledger-governors-design).

label: Audit a flow
notes: params: flow. The crown's clerks go through the governor's books: a credible letter with the month's true figures, and a skimmer caught (spec 2026-09-30-ledger-governors-design).

label: Open or close a trade route
notes: params: kingdom, open (0|1). Closing it forgoes its toll and angers the merchants — the guildmaster's goodwill, trade_close_opinion; the kingdom's own relationship is untouched until diplomacy is state (spec 2026-09-30-ledger-industry-trade-design M6).

label: Give a regiment a supply point
notes: spec 2026-10-07-army-supply-lines §4. params: regiment, town (a realm burg within supply_point_max_days of wagons), rate (800|1000|1200). A courier rides to the town; the line flows when its first wagons reach the column.

label: Withdraw a regiment's supply point
notes: params: regiment. A courier rides to the supply town; the wagons stop when he arrives.

label: Set how many days a regiment carries
notes: params: regiment, days (a data/army_carry_loads.csv row). A courier rides to the regiment.

label: Put a unit into its town's seat
notes: params: regiment (a land unit of the player's realm camped by a town of the realm). Rides by courier from the capital; when it arrives the unit takes the town's seat and the unit that held it takes its camp (spec 2026-10-07-army-split-and-ground §4.5).

label: Decree a law
notes: spec 2026-10-08-laws-tab-design §3. params: law (a law_code of data/laws.csv), value (one of its values: a range's whole number, a toggle's on or off, a choice's name). The decree rides by courier to every province the realm holds (economy and politics laws) or to every camp and every land unit in the field (military laws); each place follows it from the day its courier arrives. Each law has its own cooldown.
